purpose: Purposes Healing agent Oral pain reliever Oral antimicrobial and healing agent
indications_and_usage: Uses for the temporary relief of pain and to help prevent infection and promote healing of: canker sores cold sores fever blisters minor irritation, injury, cuts or other sores of the mouth and gums.
stop_use: Stop use and ask a doctor if sore mouth symptoms do not improve in 7 days swelling, rash, fever or other allergic reaction develops irritation, pain or redness persists or worsens
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children. If excessive product is swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
dosage_and_administration: Directions Adults and children of any age, apply to the affected area as needed Children under 12 years of age should be supervised in the use of this product
storage_and_handling: Other information store at 68° to 77°F (20° to 25°C) if liquefied, refrigerate 10 minutes to thicken
inactive_ingredient: Inactive ingredients oxygenated olive oil, pure essential oil (cinnamon)
